1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.SurfacePathReversal
2 
3 /-! Intrinsic distance on the actual boundary, defined from the existing
4 continuous surface paths. The distance is finite and attained. -/
5 
6 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
7 
8 open Set
9 open scoped ENNReal NNReal
10 
11 /-- The infimum of lengths of continuous routes on the boundary. -/
12 noncomputable def surfaceEDist (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (a b : Space) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
13   ⨅ path : P.SurfacePath a b, path.length
14 
15 /-- Real-valued intrinsic distance; its metric properties are asserted on boundary points. -/
16 noncomputable def surfaceDist (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (a b : Space) : ℝ :=
17   (P.surfaceEDist a b).toReal
18 
19 /-- Every route bounds the intrinsic distance above. -/
20 theorem SurfacePath.surfaceEDist_le_length {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a b : Space} (path : P.SurfacePath a b) :
21     P.surfaceEDist a b ≤ path.length := iInf_le _ path
22 
23 /-- Intrinsic distance is never smaller than the Euclidean chord. -/
24 theorem edist_le_surfaceEDist (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (a b : Space) :
25     edist a b ≤ P.surfaceEDist a b := le_iInf fun path => path.chord_le_length
26 
27 /-- Reversing routes makes intrinsic distance symmetric. -/
28 theorem surfaceEDist_comm (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (a b : Space) :
29     P.surfaceEDist a b = P.surfaceEDist b a := by
30   have bound (x y : Space) : P.surfaceEDist x y ≤ P.surfaceEDist y x := by
31     apply le_iInf
32     intro path
33     exact path.reverse.surfaceEDist_le_length.trans_eq path.reverse_length
34   exact le_antisymm (bound a b) (bound b a)
35 
36 /-- A shortest route realizes the intrinsic distance. -/
37 theorem SurfacePath.length_eq_surfaceEDist {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a b : Space}
38     (path : P.SurfacePath a b) (shortest : path.IsShortest) : path.length = P.surfaceEDist a b :=
39   le_antisymm (le_iInf shortest) path.surfaceEDist_le_length
40 
41 /-- The shortest-path existence theorem shows that the infimum is attained and finite. -/
42 theorem exists_surface_distance_path (P : ConvexPolyhedron) {a b : Space}
43     (ha : a ∈ frontier P.body) (hb : b ∈ frontier P.body) :
44     ∃ path : P.SurfacePath a b, path.IsShortest ∧ path.length ≠ ⊤ ∧
45       path.length = P.surfaceEDist a b := by
46   obtain ⟨path, shortest, finite⟩ := P.exists_shortest_surface_path ha hb
47   exact ⟨path, shortest, finite, le_antisymm (le_iInf shortest) path.surfaceEDist_le_length⟩
48 
49 /-- Intrinsic distances between boundary points are finite. -/
50 theorem surfaceEDist_ne_top (P : ConvexPolyhedron) {a b : Space}
51     (ha : a ∈ frontier P.body) (hb : b ∈ frontier P.body) : P.surfaceEDist a b ≠ ⊤ := by
52   obtain ⟨path, _, finite, equal⟩ := P.exists_surface_distance_path ha hb
53   exact equal ▸ finite
54 
55 /-- Within any whole face the intrinsic distance is exactly the Euclidean distance. -/
56 theorem surfaceEDist_eq_edist_in_face (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (F : P.Face) {a b : Space}
57     (ha : a ∈ F.val) (hb : b ∈ F.val) : P.surfaceEDist a b = edist a b := by
58   exact le_antisymm
59     ((SurfacePath.inFace F ha hb).surfaceEDist_le_length.trans_eq (SurfacePath.inFace_length F ha hb))
60     (P.edist_le_surfaceEDist a b)
61 
62 /-- A boundary point has zero intrinsic distance from itself. -/
63 theorem surfaceEDist_self (P : ConvexPolyhedron) {a : Space} (ha : a ∈ frontier P.body) :
64     P.surfaceEDist a a = 0 := by
65   obtain ⟨F, aF⟩ := P.boundary_point_in_face ha
66   rw [P.surfaceEDist_eq_edist_in_face F aF aF, edist_self]
67 
68 /-- Concatenating minimizing routes proves the intrinsic triangle inequality. -/
69 theorem surfaceEDist_triangle (P : ConvexPolyhedron) {a b c : Space}
70     (ha : a ∈ frontier P.body) (hb : b ∈ frontier P.body) (hc : c ∈ frontier P.body) :
71     P.surfaceEDist a c ≤ P.surfaceEDist a b + P.surfaceEDist b c := by
72   obtain ⟨first, _, _, first_length⟩ := P.exists_surface_distance_path ha hb
73   obtain ⟨second, _, _, second_length⟩ := P.exists_surface_distance_path hb hc
74   have bound := (first.join second).surfaceEDist_le_length
75   rwa [SurfacePath.join_length, first_length, second_length] at bound
76 
77 /-- Real intrinsic distance is nonnegative. -/
78 theorem surfaceDist_nonneg (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (a b : Space) : 0 ≤ P.surfaceDist a b :=
79   ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
80 
81 theorem surfaceDist_comm (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (a b : Space) :
82     P.surfaceDist a b = P.surfaceDist b a := by rw [surfaceDist, surfaceDist, P.surfaceEDist_comm]
83 
84 theorem dist_le_surfaceDist (P : ConvexPolyhedron) {a b : Space}
85     (ha : a ∈ frontier P.body) (hb : b ∈ frontier P.body) : dist a b ≤ P.surfaceDist a b := by
86   simpa only [surfaceDist, edist_dist, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal dist_nonneg] using
87     ENNReal.toReal_mono (P.surfaceEDist_ne_top ha hb) (P.edist_le_surfaceEDist a b)
88 
89 theorem surfaceDist_eq_dist_in_face (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (F : P.Face) {a b : Space}
90     (ha : a ∈ F.val) (hb : b ∈ F.val) : P.surfaceDist a b = dist a b := by
91   rw [surfaceDist, P.surfaceEDist_eq_edist_in_face F ha hb, edist_dist, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal dist_nonneg]
92 
93 theorem surfaceDist_self (P : ConvexPolyhedron) {a : Space} (ha : a ∈ frontier P.body) :
94     P.surfaceDist a a = 0 := by rw [surfaceDist, P.surfaceEDist_self ha, ENNReal.toReal_zero]
95 
96 theorem surfaceDist_triangle (P : ConvexPolyhedron) {a b c : Space}
97     (ha : a ∈ frontier P.body) (hb : b ∈ frontier P.body) (hc : c ∈ frontier P.body) :
98     P.surfaceDist a c ≤ P.surfaceDist a b + P.surfaceDist b c := by
99   have bound := ENNReal.toReal_mono (ENNReal.add_ne_top.mpr
100     ⟨P.surfaceEDist_ne_top ha hb, P.surfaceEDist_ne_top hb hc⟩) (P.surfaceEDist_triangle ha hb hc)
101   simpa only [surfaceDist, ENNReal.toReal_add (P.surfaceEDist_ne_top ha hb)
102     (P.surfaceEDist_ne_top hb hc)] using bound
103 
104 /-- Zero intrinsic distance identifies boundary points. -/
105 theorem surfaceDist_eq_zero_iff (P : ConvexPolyhedron) {a b : Space}
106     (ha : a ∈ frontier P.body) (hb : b ∈ frontier P.body) : P.surfaceDist a b = 0 ↔ a = b := by
107   constructor
108   · intro zero
109     exact dist_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm ((P.dist_le_surfaceDist ha hb).trans_eq zero) dist_nonneg)
110   · rintro rfl
111     exact P.surfaceDist_self ha
112 
113 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
